value.rationale: The unique nine-point affine Steiner system is a canonical, nonbinary rank-three matroid. Knowing the base count or an ambient projective signed spectrum does not explicitly supply the nine-point geometric projection kernel or the evaluated globally minimal endpoint projection norm without additional combinatorial and operator-norm arguments. These determine sharp information recovery for a natural Boolean incidence distribution, and the 97/16 endpoint extremality is among arbitrary projections, not merely equivariant ones. Exact natural finite classifications are valuable even without a claimed infinite-family extension.
